items.desc: A high-end resource that is very rare and very pricy.

items.name: Quartz Sand
items.desc: A valuable currency in Magrasea. Can be used to purchase rare materials.
items.source: Obtained from Missions; Achievements; Exception Protocol Cleanups; Stage First-clear Rewards; Sign-ins

items.name: Advanced Search Command
items.desc: Advanced Search Command for the Search Terminal.
items.source: Purchased from Supplies Shop; Sign-ins; Endless Exploration

items.name: Nighttide 10x Search Command
items.desc:
Can be used only in Exclusive Search [Nighttide Predator] for a 10x Search.
Capable of summoning many elite operatives at once. Encrypted proof of identity has been placed inside, allowing Headquarters to quickly and accurately match user identities. Due to the need for safety and discretion, this Command is time-limited.

items.name: Deepscar 10x Search Command
items.desc:
Only usable in the Exclusive Search [Fallen Bird] to perform a 10x Search.
Capable of summoning multiple elite Dolls, furnished with encrypted IDs to allow HQ to quickly and accurately determine the identity of the recruited personnel. Due to security and confidentiality requirements, this permit is only effective for a limited time.

items.name: Dayspring 10x Search Command
items.desc:
Only usable in the Exclusive Search [Breaking Dawn] to perform a 10x Search.
Capable of summoning multiple elite Dolls, furnished with encrypted IDs to allow HQ to quickly and accurately determine the identity of the recruited personnel. Due to security and confidentiality requirements, this permit is only effective for a limited time.

items.name: Limited-Time 10x Search Command
items.desc:
A special search command that can only be used during [Scars Among Pigeons & Daisies], allowing you to conduct a single 10x search in Elite Search, Targeted Search, or Advanced Search.
A limited-time advanced search command for use with the Search Terminal.

items.name: Darkstar 10x Search Command
items.desc:
Only usable in the Exclusive Search [Fading Starlight] to perform a 10x Search.
Allows you to perform a single search for multiple elite Dolls. Contains encrypted ID documents that allow HQ to quickly and accurately identify the recruits. Due to steep requirements for safety and privacy, this search command is only valid for a limited time.

items.name: Time-Leap 10x Search Command
items.desc:
A 10x Search Command that can only be used in the "Truth-Seeking Kronos" banner.
Allows you to perform a single search for multiple elite Dolls. Contains encrypted ID documents that allow HQ to quickly and accurately identify the recruits. Due to steep requirements for safety and privacy, this search command is only valid for a limited time.

items.name: Starry Sky Arclight 10x Search Command
items.desc:
A 10x Search Command that can only be used in the "Dazzling Arclight" banner.
Allows you to perform a single search for multiple elite Dolls. Contains encrypted ID documents that allow HQ to quickly and accurately identify the recruits. Due to steep requirements for safety and privacy, this search command is only valid for a limited time.

items.name: Violet 10x Search Command
items.desc:
A 10x Search Command that can only be used in the ""Ethereal Lilac"" banner .
Allows you to perform a single search for multiple elite Dolls. Contains encrypted ID documents that allow HQ to quickly and accurately identify the recruits. Due to steep requirements for safety and privacy, this search command is only valid for a limited time.

items.name: Nirvana 10x Search Command
items.desc:
A 10x Search Command that can only be used in the "Fervid Nirvana" banner.
Allows you to perform a single search for multiple elite Dolls. A newly introduced module allows for a chance to locate and awaken the special Doll [Inferno Sol]. Due to steep requirements for safety and privacy, this search command is only valid for a limited time.

items.name: Neural Kit
items.desc: A necessity in reconstructing Doll Neural Fragments. The safekeeping of these kits should be prioritized.
items.source: Automatically converted upon obtaining Doll duplicates from Neural Search

items.name: Projection Voucher
items.desc: Presented by Riko. Get a custom-made exclusive attire projection for your Doll with a certain amount of Projection Vouchers. "We have every design you could ever think of! Imagine the smile on your Doll's face when they put on their new projection. What are you still waiting for?"
items.source: Purchased from store; obtained from special events

items.name: High Fashion Voucher
items.desc: Using the latest projection technology, one can further refine the appearance of existing outfits. As for their exact effects... Why don't you try it out for yourself? Honest Riko would NEVER palm shoddy goods off on you!

items.name: Thank-You Letter
items.desc: "Thank you, Miss Luna! Your fortune-telling helped clear up the doubts I've had for a long time..." The relatively neat handwriting on the letter exudes the sender's sincere feelings. Luna has received countless thank-you letters like this. Perhaps they're a form of affirmation for her.

items.name: Crystallization of Feelings
items.desc: When one's trust is solid enough and one's relationship is close enough, a special sentiment is silently born... And thus the feelings you've given are exchanged for a brand new future.

items.name: Oath Certificate
items.desc: On the cloud, the programs needed to establish an oath are very special. They form a direct link between neural clouds—in other words, an imprint on the soul itself.

items.name: Ema
items.desc: A five-sided ema inscribed with lovely designs. Visitors can write their wishes on it. Whether they're hopes for daily life, wishes for love, or even weird wishes like "I hope that greenhair suffers a little!", Kimie will collect them and convey them to the kami.

items.name: ROBOPUP Chocolate
items.desc: A brand of boxed chocolate sold exclusively within the Helios Sector, it has a unique package design. Since it's made by Choco's Chocolaterie, its taste is above question. This item is very popular in the Helios Sector and it has a special meaning in Penumbra's eyes.

items.name: "Friendship of Paired Wings" Oath Certificate
items.desc: Within a timeframe that is "limited", establish an oath which is "eternal". This is the choice of Steins Gate.
items.source: Acquired by playing [World Line Exploration] during the [Retrocausal Trie Interference] event

items.name: Root Beer
items.desc: A mixture of an excess of sugary syrup, carbon, and sassafras, resulting in an indescribably strange taste. Beer's in the name, but there's no alcohol content. No need to worry about legal consequences for driving after drinking. How did Bonneville come to like this taste, though?

items.name: Basic Search Command
items.desc: Basic Search Command for the Search Terminal.

items.name: Precious Memory Ticket
items.desc: Can you really turn back the hands of time? We haven't found the answer yet. However, these exchange tickets specially provided by Riko might let you return to those memories. This time, hold on tight to the good old days.
items.source: Acquired during events; purchased from the Multidimensional Value Shop; purchased from the Recollection Shop

items.name: Diggcoin
items.desc: Magrasea's common currency. Can be used to purchase most of the basic supplies.
items.source: Stage drops; Resource Collection - DGC Collection drops; Extracted in the Factory

items.name: Combat EXP
items.desc: Combat Experience Dolls gain during battles. Can be used to level up Dolls.
items.source: Obtained from Explorations; Resource Collection - EXP Collection drops

items.name: Spirit Data
items.desc: Specialized data packs used to upgrade Spirits. Highly efficient when raising Spirits, but does not have the same effect on agents.

items.name: Evolution Decree
items.desc: A permit for Spirit advancement. By using this advancement device, you can increase the rank of a Spirit and vastly improve its powers.
items.source: Spirit Generation, purchased from the Shop

items.name: Recombination Decree
items.desc: A permit for recombining Spirit skills. By using this recombination device, you can change Spirit skills and have them learn different abilities

items.name: Generation Decree
items.desc: A scripture containing a Spirit's core program that can be used to manifest Spirits. With the aid of this manifestation device, you can manifest Spirits and bring blessings upon Magrasea.
items.source: Purchased from the shop, obtained from daily missions.

items.name: Prefab Unit
items.desc: Consumable for building construction, and also for producing certain materials at the Factory. These are nothing rare, but they are indispensable.
items.source: Produced in the Engineering Department; Extracted in the Factory; Stage First-clear Rewards

items.name: Algorithm Fragment
items.desc: Item obtained from Algorithm Decomposition.

items.name: Algorithm Optimization Kit
items.desc: Item consumed when performing Algorithm Substat Optimization.

items.name: Ether Token
items.desc: Tokens obtained from Exception Protocol Cleanups. Can be used to redeem rare items in the Exception Protocol section of the Supplies Shop.

items.name: Discrete Points
items.desc: Special currency that can be used to redeem various rare items in the shop. Only available through converting Discrete Signals.
items.source: Converted from unused Discrete Signals after the end of a time-limited Targeted Search

items.name: Reputation Point
items.desc: Doing for others gives joy back. The help you once provided to others will in turn make you stronger.
items.source: Points are collected in the Supplies Shop, and earned from lending and setting up Support Dolls

items.name: Furniture Coins
items.desc: Special Operand consumed in furniture building. In Magrasea, clients are supposed to provide such basic materials for furniture designers to work on.
items.source: Weekly Mission Activity Bonus; Redeemed with Quartz Sand

items.name: Glitter Chip
items.desc: Solidified Operand discovered in the hollows. Its high information density makes it an excellent material for manufacturing memory cards for mobile terminals. Collect Glitter Chips to redeem rare items in the Vulnerability Check section of the Supplies Shop.

items.name: Missing Data
items.desc: Data fragments scattered in the Copley Sector. With these we may figure out what secrets are buried in those entropic data disks.
items.source: Obtained by spending Keys during the "Divine Heresy" event; obtained by playing "Divine Heresy" event stages

items.name: Mottled Dogtag
items.desc: The language of war is carved on this little piece of metal with blades and gunfire.

items.name: Livestream Donation
items.desc: A specialized stream gift from the Burbank Sector. Through the marvels of advanced compression workmanship, it contains a plethora of Operand. In the past, it was gifted to other Agents to represent favor and affection. Now? Now they all belong to the great Kuro, of course!

items.name: Neural Element
items.desc: A basic component used in just about everything found in Ascension Sector. Can be used as currency in Aberrance's Chain's "Exchange Center" and traded for various items.
items.source: Obtained by playing "Structural Trials" during the "Aberrance's Chain" event.

items.name: R&D Point
items.desc: A module containing many computation and simulation programs in compressed form. They can be used to upgrade certain research projects in the "Survival Strategies" system of the Aberrance's Chain event.
items.source: Obtained by spending Keys during while the Aberrance's Chain event is running, as well as by playing "Structural Trials".

items.name: Trial Permit
items.desc: A permit released after passing primary screening reviews. Trial Permits can be spent to attempt the "Structural Trial" stages of the Aberrance's Chain event.
items.source: Obtained by spending Keys during while the Aberrance's Chain event is running.

items.name: Red Packet
items.desc: A gift specially prepared by Daiyan to welcome the new spring and given to everyone who takes part in the New Year celebration event. If you see Riko trying to buy up red packets at low prices, please inform Persicaria so she can take care of it.
items.source: Obtained during the "Magrasea's Lang Syne" event.

items.name: Coarse Imaging Cocoa Powder
items.desc:
Sprinkle it on the developer machine and make a wish, and you'll get a random picture!
Will be removed once the event ends, so please make sure you use it on the "Pure White Album" in time.
items.source: Obtained during the "Heartfelt House of Cocoa" event.

items.name: Fine Imaging Cocoa Powder
items.desc:
Sprinkle it on the developer machine and make a wish, and you'll get a specific picture!
Will be removed once the event ends, so please make sure you use it on the "Pure White Album" in time.
items.source: Obtained during the "Heartfelt House of Cocoa" event.

items.name: Acceleration Card
items.desc: Accelerates the operation cycle of various devices and finishes work ahead of time!

items.name: Inspirational Slip
items.desc: A slip containing the inspiration Nora gained after walking around outside. Although most of the content within ended up discarded, the slips are very popular with the fans of her work.

items.name: WF Token
items.desc: An encrypted token distributed during the Wishing Fist Tournament that serves as a betting chip during boxing matches.
items.source: Obtained during the "Eager Fist, Dawning Fray" event.

items.name: Baalia Horn
items.desc: Items dropped after wiping out Baalia's summons. They look like sheep horns, but the data that makes them up seems to contain some kind of secret.

items.name: Returner's Resupply Order
items.desc: A rare currency obtained from the "Return to Oasis" event. Can be used to take part in Returner's Supplies and unlock higher-level reward levels in the Returner's Fund.
items.source: Obtained during the "Return to Oasis" event.

items.name: Growth Factor
items.desc: An important polypeptide that stimulates cell growth and differentiation, an indispensable material for when Helix performs DNA restoration.

items.name: Festival Ticket
items.desc:
Tickets for various activities and entertainment in the Burbank Festival, also serving as memorabilia.
80% of its storage has been filled up with the details about events, but not a soul is going to look at that.
items.source: Acquired through Key conversion during [Inverted Mordent Resonance]

items.name: Tactical Technology Point
items.desc:
Acquired during the exploration of the Burbank Sector. Can be used in upgrading certain programs within [Inverted Mordent Resonance]'s [Survival Strategies]. 
It's dangerous to go alone, take it!
items.source: Acquired through Key conversion during [Inverted Mordent Resonance]; challenge [Inverted Mordent Resonance] event stages

items.name: Core Technology Point
items.desc:
Acquired during the exploration of the Burbank Sector. Can be used in activating important programs within [Inverted Mordent Resonance]'s [Survival Strategies]. 
One of the few secrets to survival is as such — grasping the core technologies.

items.name: "Calling of the Masses"
items.desc:
Records of the Oasis Holidaying Squad's observations during the festival. Used to progress exploration. 
"The moment I heard laughter, that's when survival became life instead."

items.name: Reboot Seed
items.desc:
A valuable tool inside the Burbank Sector, capable of resetting the branches of [Survival Strategies]. 
This is the supposed human cure for regret, huh?

items.name: Fairground Point
items.desc:
Score accumulated from playing around in the Oasis Fairgrounds. 
Every point is a record of a happy time.

items.name: Cultural Notes
items.desc: A thin piece of paper containing notes on cultural practices. The handwriting is a little messy. Zangyin prefers to record her insights on pen and paper rather than use electronic devices.

items.name: Meal Vouchers
items.desc: A crudely-made plastic card with a special code on its surface. Some restaurants adhere to the ancient formula of "Pay → Collect Voucher → Collect Food By Exchanging Voucher". Millau feels that there's more of a ritual feel to this proess compared to unfeeling smart meal cases.

items.name: AP Round Casings
items.desc: Small-caliber ammunition used by Clukay's personal weapon, the 416 assault rifle and possesses remarkable killing power. Clukay collects these casings, both to remove her traces, and to hang onto what memories she can.

items.name: Gestalt Aspect
items.desc: Data modules in the Pass specialized for use in the Neural Projection system. For the cost of a certain amount of Gestalt Aspects, Neural Projections exclusive to the Pass can be acquired. "The flowerage of summer's peak, a warming drink in winter's depths. Let us preserve them. First sights are bound to be worth revisiting, no?"
items.source: Acquired through buying [Gestalt Aspect Supply Pack]

items.name: Nameless Petals
items.desc: Wild flowers, commonplace on the battlefield. In moments of respite between the rains of fire and brimstone, Clotho sought to gather these fallen petals. Their passing was no less worthy of interment.

items.name: Refight Overflow Energy
items.desc: Folding the dimension of time and repeating a battle that has already been fought causes the overflow of excess energy. It can be traded at the Multidimensional Value Region of the Shop for rare items.

items.name: Returner's Resupply Command Lite
items.desc: A rare currency obtained during the [Return to the Oasis Lite] event. Can be used to win prizes from the Returner's Resupply.
items.source: Acquired during [Return to the Oasis Lite]

items.name: Entropic Core Fragments
items.desc:
An item obtained through the "Critical Cascade" event, which can be used to purchase items.
When destroyed, certain Entropics leave behind irregularly-shaped, light purple data blocks. They can be processed into raw materials for producing all kind of items.
items.source: Obtained during the "Combustion Cycle" challenge stages of the "Critical Cascade" event.

items.name: Action Permit
items.desc:
Used to take part in combat missions during the "Critical Cascade" event.
When something big happens, warzone permits are needed to go on operations. Filled with the agents' courage and determination.
items.source: Acquired during [Critical Cascade] through conversion of used Keys

items.desc:
An item obtained through the "Critical Cascade" event, which can be used to unlock or upgrade nodes in the Survival Strategies system.
<size=20>100,000 lines of operating principles have been omitted. For more information please speak to the professionals of the Oasis' Technical Department.</size>
items.source: Acquired during [Critical Cascade] through conversion of used Keys; also through attempting [Combustion Cycle]

items.name: Special Ops Re-Trial Voucher
items.desc: Special Vouchers distributed by Headquarters, anti-forgery chips included. They allow the revisiting of already completed Special Operations. For Dolls such as Clukay, with a preference for the unorthodox and an eye for unconventional tactics, it serves as both a method of self-improvement, and a way to burn some time.
items.source: Acquired During [Divergent Shadows] through conversion of used Keys

items.name: Relic Remnants
items.desc: What remains of the legendary treasures of the azure, spoken of in legend. A singular piece has no apparent value, but some secret is sure to lie betwixt.

items.name: Twilight Re-Trial Voucher
items.desc: Special Vouchers distributed by Headquarters, anti-forgery chips included. They allow the revisiting of already completed Rescue Operations. Even if it is no more than simulation, Clotho shall stand firm against whatever seeks to harm those behind her. Thus is her resolve, rooted deep within.
items.source: Acquired During [Divergent Shadows] through conversion of used Keys

items.name: Pumpkin
items.desc: Can be used in the Halloween Season, and restores Team HP upon consumption
items.source: Can be collected in the Halloween Season, and increases pumpkin count upon collection.

items.name: Enigma Retraining Permit
items.desc: A special permit issued by HQ with anti-counterfeiting chips installed inside. Possessing them allows you to replay already-solved cases. Rather than revisit the actual events of the past, Dupin prefers to sit in his room in real life and quietly ponder them. Penetrating the fog of mystery and cutting to the truth — sometimes solitude is a form of enjoyment too.
items.source: Obtained through conversion of keys during the "L.A.D. Riddle" event

items.desc: Place your wishes on a Lucky Star and then cast them into the Wish Pool or the Gift Pool! Once the event is over, there will be a lucky draw for the Professors who took part in the event, and the winners will have merchandise sent to their homes.

items.name: Stealthy Retraining Permit
items.desc: A special permit issued by HQ with anti-counterfeiting chips inside. Possessing one allows you to review past special ops. Move by stealth, take them by surprise, kill in one blow, and vanish without a sound.

items.name: Race Retraining Permit
items.desc: A special permit distributed by the Ops Room, with anti-counterfeiting chips. Allows you to run through open road races already won again. What? You said you were only a second behind me? A second behind me is still my win. Gimme the keys.

items.name: Recopy Core Chip
items.desc: Magrasea's stories are engraved in the cloud server and reproduced in the core chips. Reading these logs in chronological order is like flipping through the pages of a life. Can be used to unlock certain story scenes from the main storyline.

items.name: Strategic Blueprint
items.desc: Material for upgrading strategies. The strategic planning of when and how to use these materials is also going to play a key part in winning.
items.source: Obtained from the First-clear Rewards of each sector's Endless Mode

items.desc: Consumable material for boosting Algorithm Efficiency. Use it to get +20 points of Efficiency EXP.

items.desc: Consumable material for Algorithm Reconstruction. It replaces any one of the Algorithms required.

items.name: Fast Food
items.desc: Burger and fries. This should help easing the hunger during missions. Gift it to a Doll to raise your Intimacy level with them.
items.source: Drops from Fragment Search; Produced in the Factory

items.name: Petit Four
items.desc: A small piece of cake. It's sweet and creamy, and can be kept overnight. Gift it to a Doll to raise your Intimacy level with them.
items.source: Drops from Fragment Search; Produced in the Factory

items.name: Honey
items.desc: A jar of raw honey. It tastes delicate and sweet, and is perfect for milk tea and home-baked cakes or direct consumption. Gift it to a Doll to raise your Intimacy level with them.
items.source: Drops from Fragment Search; Produced in the Factory

items.name: Oden
items.desc: Fish balls, crab sticks, and kelp. It's a box of Oden. Gift it to a Doll to raise your Intimacy level with them.
items.source: Drops from Fragment Search; Produced in the Factory

items.name: Plushie Charm
items.desc: A charm designed after a mysterious creature. A popular present among the Dolls. Gift it to a Doll to raise your Intimacy level with them.
items.source: Drops from Fragment Search; Produced in the Factory

items.name: Digital Toy Brick
items.desc: A classic toy recreated on the cloud with Operand. There are endless possibilities in how these bricks can be combined together. Gift it to a Doll to raise your Intimacy level with them.
items.source: Drops from Fragment Search; Produced in the Factory

items.name: Practice Shinai
items.desc: This practice shinai has perfectly imitated the texture of bamboo. It reminds those training in martial arts of the day when everything had started. Gift it to a Doll to raise your Intimacy level with them.

items.desc:
Open to obtain 1 Orange quality Algorithm from the [Exploit] set.
2Pcs: Skill Haste +10%.
3Pcs: Deal 10% additional damage to enemies with an active debuff. For every active debuff, deal 2% more damage to that target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

items.name: Stack

Open to obtain 1 Orange quality Algorithm from the [Stack] set.
2Pcs: Base Hashrate +15%.
3Pcs: Every 3 normal attacks will create a stack of [Pursuit Ordnance], max 4 stacks. Every stack deals an additional 10% of Doll's Hashrate in [Derivative] Operand damage.

items.name: Resolve

2Pcs: Damage reduction +5%.
3Pcs: When HP is lower than 50%, gain 10% damage reduction. From then onwards, for every 10% of HP lost, gain 5% damage reduction. Every change in HP will refresh the value of this damage reduction.

items.name: Limit Value

2Pcs: Damage Dealt +5%.
3Pcs: When dealing damage to an enemy with higher Max HP, additionally deal [Derivative] damage equal to (6% + Enemy Max HP/Self Max HP × 3%), of the same damage type as the original attack, with a maximum of 20%.

items.name: Quenching Operation Medal
items.desc:
Not long after the Military Games ended, Python received a crude, handmade medal. The sender was "Your Student".
—There are some accolades and accomplishment which don't need to be acknowledged by others.

items.name: Kuro's Die-hard Fan Medal
items.desc: This medal is an ultra-rare customized floral print version that is only awarded to fans who have accompanied Kuro through the toughest of times and consistently helped push Kuro's livestream up in the rankings. Thanks for your support!

items.name: Handmade Scent Sachet
items.desc: Daiyan went out of her way to ask Chanzhi to teach her how to make this scent sachet after the New Year celebration. In a world where everything can be rapidly fabricated through a program, Daiyan chose to carefully sew each stitch of it and imbue it with her feelings, before giving it to the person she wanted to thank.
items.source: Obtained from the event "Magrasea's Lang Syne".

items.name: Japanese-style Wooden Bookmark
items.desc: Themed after one of Nora's prided works, "Wrath of the Land", this special bookmark differs from others in that there is only one of them.

items.name: Boxing Glove
items.desc: A Magnhilda-exclusive boxing glove which has witnessed her suffering and struggles until she won the champion's trophy for the Wishing Fist Tournament. To Magnhilda, the glory of victory is not hers alone.
items.source: Obtained from the event "Eager Fist, Dawning Fray".

items.name: Lab Rat Dangle
items.desc: A backpack dangle patterned after Helix's pet white mouse. After being accidentally damaged on the battlefield, the maverick street artist Banxsy recolored it, which has also made it Helix's most prized possession.

items.name: Retro Snake Handheld
items.desc: This handheld has a polyacetate casing, a monochrome display, only comes with 8KB of RAM and the only game in it is Snake; yet it's enough to fascinate Zangyin. The snake sprite in the game is the source of Little Si's cloud server image, and no matter where she goes, Zangyin never forgets to bring the ancient game console with her.

items.name: Chinese-style Tableware Collection
items.desc:
Millau commissioned a craftsman to make this set on dining utensils after returning to France, in order to commemorate her unforgettable trip to China. She's madly in love with this uniquely-styled tableware set, having used it to slowly learn and like chopsticks, and she hopes that anyone using this tableware set will be able to understand the allure of food.
"—Make sure you eat properly!"

items.name: Clukay's Hairclip
items.desc:
The hairclip that one can find on Clukay's personage day to day. Exactly where the inspiration for their shape and modelling is a subject of much varied debate, but it can be said without doubt that these have become synonymous with her.
"I've never seen her with them off." You would receive the same answer from everyone that knew her. Only she herself knew that this pair of delicate hairpins had once been doffed, and laid within the palms of a certain someone.

items.name: Fingertwixt Rhopalogheist
items.desc: Butterflies, fluttering and circling around Clotho, always appearing from within the coffin after the last rites of a Doll have been performed. Naught but this one have accompanied her from Alpha to Omega, through the darkest of nights.

items.name: Truth Pocketwatch
items.desc: A pocketwatch that Dupin carries everywhere. Its name is "Truth". The sound of its second hand when on a case, the meshing of its gears when at leisure — The "tick-tock, tick tock" sounds that Truth makes stimulates a detective's thoughts, until the night comes to an end.

items.name: Navy Plume
items.desc: A soft feather from Undine's uniform hat. As part of a royal-grade uniform, it has accompanied Undine through the peaks of success and the depths of despair. This soft, yet unbreakable feather symbolizes the resilience of Undine's Ceremonial Orchestra.

items.name: Bonded Dolls
items.desc:
A pair of Dolls made in imitation of Jiangyu and her most treasured person. It is finely stitched and tremendously life-like, bearing the bond and feelings of its owner.
"Though we are two individuals, we are the same deep down. Once we were inseparable, but now we can only gaze at each other from afar."

items.name: Starry Tarot Deck
items.desc:
A tarot deck that Yelena carries with her wherever she goes. Despite her care for it, the passage of time has still left its traces on it.
At the crux of destiny, crisis, solutions, misery and new beginnings all intersect beneath the light of the "stars". This is Yelena's choice, and also a precious memory for her.

items.name: Mysterious Reading Material
items.desc:
A thick book that Erika carries with her at all times. Its hard leather cover is stitched with golden thread and it appears to be nothing more than a boring piece of scripture which only a cleric would peruse.
However... it's probably best that you look at it yourself. Perhaps you might learn about a hidden side of her.

items.name: Energia Energy Drink
items.desc:
An energy drink that Cascadia always carries with her. The bottle is a fancy new design that looks vaguely like a battery. Its flavor is her favorite blueberry and kumquat mix: sour with a hint of bitterness.
In hazardous situations, this drink might well be her only source of energy, and thus it is literally "the water of life" for her.

items.name: Zoo Excursion Voucher
items.desc: A handmade voucher for a zoo outing, personally made by Taisch. She has drawn cute animals on it with crayons. Supposedly, all sorts of bizarre things can happen in Taisch's zoo.

items.name: Fated Encounter
items.desc:
This is Eos' earring. In certain settings, Eos will show up wearing just one earring. Few people know the significance of doing so and most agents think it's just a element of her personal style.
"Just like how the dawn is when day and night meet, so too is this a symbol of my encounter with you, the proof of my journey from delusion to reality."

items.name: Runestone
items.desc: A runestone that Luna carries on her person. A golden rune has been carved on this polished runestone, filled with endless mystery. Not only is it an ancient arcane sigil, it is also a faithful witness to everything Luna has experienced.

items.name: Kagura Bells
items.desc: The kagura-suzu that Kimie uses during ceremonies. They are exquisitely made and can produce crisp, clear sounds with even the slightest movement. This item connects her to the infinite kami as her long sleeves and crimson skirts dance.

items.name: Crescent Scythe
items.desc: These lethal chopping swords are steeped in history and have been imbued with great meaning and symbolism. They are also Penumbra's favored weapons, capable of cleaving targets in half with a single blow. One is called "Al-Haqq", or "Truth", and the other is called "Al-Maliq", or "Lord".

items.name: LabMem No. 00X
items.desc: The letters inscribed in this badge bear witness to the bonds forged during the time we spent together as allies—OSHMKUFAN 2063. Through time, world lines, and causality itself, you will always be a Laboratory member.
items.source: Acquired during the [Retrocausal Trie Interference] event

items.name: Rubber Ducky Ornament
items.desc:
A rubber ducky glued onto a motorcycle's handlebars. Makes a ""quack"" sound when squeezed, and draws a curious contrast with the assertive and aggressive style of the vehicle. 
This ducky was given to you as a gift. Past landscapes speak to you, telling you that the road forward need not be travelled alone.

items.name: Teddy Rag-Doll
items.desc: A supposedly hand-sewn teddy bear, rough around the edges. Some of the threads are even visible, but the effort put into it is obvious, as well as some of the creator's whimsical sprouting ideas—could Shale have made this herself?

items.name: Splintered Thorn
items.desc: A small thorn that's had its toxin removed, apparently removed from Belladonna's very own horns. It has witnessed her pain, loneliness and growth, but she doesn't have to bear all of that alone anymore.

items.name: Doggo No.1
items.desc: A scale toy based off the automated robo-dog ""Dinergate"", popular for their cute appearance. ""Diner-dinergate!"" It looks happy to have a new master.

items.name: Iron Origami
items.desc: A handmade flower shaped from sheet metal to be used in the upcoming Cyclopes Memorial Ceremony. Despite being made as a last resort due to material shortages, it embodies the most sincere of feelings.

items.name: Verdant Pendant
items.desc:
A bottle-shaped pendant housing lush grass inside. Like its owner, it radiates a warm light accompanied by a certain lively energy.
Weak as it appears to be, it still shines like the brilliant sun, illuminating the way ahead.

items.name: Scarlet Sterling Pin
items.desc:
A silver pin, where a red gem lays embedded. Her soul, her intentions, her everything on this path with you.
No matter where the lone leaf amongst this sea of clouds drifts, please hold it well in your hand, unto eternity.

items.name: Decorative Collar
items.desc: A collar of leather, formerly a common sight in fashion shows and some avant-garde clothing stores. As a keepsake, however... it might hold some special meaning. The moment she places it in your hands, a mysterious smile appears on her face.
